description: Anything wrong, with the request's req. A request whose op the host doesn't take is answered with code unsupported_operation (error "unsupported operation"), and one whose fields aren't as the schema has them with code invalid_data_type (error "invalid data type"): the same from every host, what was wrong in detail.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

code.description: One of the schema's own refusals.

detail.description: A refusal's: what was wrong (the op, or the field and why), for a person to read; code, not this, says which refusal it is.

plain.description: Said for the user as it is.

gone.description: A session's folder gone and not made again.

text.description: memory's refusal: the memory as the Bot left it.

seen.description: memory's refusal: what the user's accepted of it.

mtime.description: memory's refusal: its mtime (ns; a phone's, seconds).
